The carrier webhook of CARRIER_HANDOFF service areas. Unauthenticated by the standing fleet decision, exactly like POST /journeys/\{trackingNumber\}/scans (the per-carrier token scheme is a recorded follow-up). Each report becomes one scan with scanId "&lt;carrierId&gt;:&lt;carrierEventId&gt;", so a re-sent report answers 409 duplicate-scan. PICKED_UP is the handoff at the journey's handoff node (a journey already WITH_CARRIER is a no-op that answers 200); OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED and DELIVERY_FAILED become their scans; IN_TRANSIT is accepted and counted without a scan.
